top_signals.title: Watch a large aerial drone evacuate a wounded Ukrainian soldier from the front line
top_signals.summary: Ukraine is expanding its use of large drones for battlefield medical evacuations. Watch as a Ukrainian team uses an aerial drone to transport a wounded soldier from a forward position to a field hospital.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: UK plans to resist EU request to match tariffs on Chinese goods
top_signals.summary: Move reduces chance Britain will be able to access subsidies and contracts under ‘Made in Europe’ rules
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: RRJ-Led Consortium Buys Australia Coal Miner’s $619 Million Debt
top_signals.summary: A consortium led by private investment firm RRJ Capital has agreed to buy $619 million of bonds from Australian coking coal miner GM3, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_signals.title: Thames Water's Rescue Deal Comes With a Dirty Catch
top_signals.summary: The saga of financially distressed Thames Water may have reached a new low. The Financial Times and others reported that the latest US bidder for the utility planned to up its bid by £ 1 billion if the government would lay off pollution mitigation requirements until 2030. Sort of, “We’ll pay you if you let us continue to dump sewage into the waterways.” (We say latest bidder because US investment firm KKR made an unsuccessful bid not long ago.) We’d rate the Thames privatization and subsequent deterioration as one…
